_comment: Operational config, fetched by installed panels (~1 h TTL). Which of these is a real lever, and what each one can actually do, is docs/INCIDENT_PLAYBOOK.md -> "The levers, and what each one can actually do". Two notes that belong next to the switches themselves: pricing_display SUPPRESSES every price shown before a run (the panel falls back to its own "Price not available" state) and leaves the generation log recording what runs cost — it hides a wrong price, it cannot correct one. strict_schema_validation is declared and allowlisted but NO code reads it: it is not a lever, do not reach for it during an incident.
